scope: Only exact archived untracked raw W cohort files outside every current Z/contingent AA frozen closure and build command. Whole source ZIP independently CRC/SHA/mode verified and matched against pushed Git bytes. Tracked source/findings, W source/native objects/full38 standalone component and all current Z/contingent AA inputs/caches/resources preserved. Recovery by explicit archive member/mode/mtime. Gross retired allocation is not net drive gain.

before.scope: Volume snapshot before later Z recovery publication and any post-gate raw-output retirement; concurrent render/build/system allocations can affect observed delta. This is not a per-action attribution.

volume_observation.scope: Observed Linux filesystem availability across the W raw-output retirement interval, including concurrent frame/system allocations. This is not an attribution of the entire volume delta to deletion; gross retired inode allocation is recorded separately. No Windows volume changes performed.
